name: Weakened Floor OLD
description: A section of the cave floor collapses under a creature, plunging it 40 feet into a chasm filled with jagged stalactites.
disable: DC 20 Survival to knock loose the unstable floor and reveal a traversable ledge to the south.

generalAbilities.name: Floor Collapse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A Small or larger creature enters the marked portion of the map

Effect The triggering creature falls, taking 20 Bludgeoning Damage{20} damage from the fall plus 3d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Reflex Saving Throw) from the stalagmites. A creature can Grab an Edge to avoid falling, or succeed at a Basic DC 20 Athletics check to climb out of the chasm.
